notes.title: The Bearer & The last flame will be in IndieDev
notes.content:
Hello!

You still don't know The Bearer & The last flame and you want to know more?
This is your chance, this videogame is coming to IndieDev!

The biggest indie videogame fair in Spain, which is back better than ever, has already started. Meetups, workshops, presentations and a lot of love for videogames. All this awaits you at IndieDev during the next 8, 9 and 10 September.

The event will take place at La Farga, located in L'Hospitalet de Llobregat, in an impressive exhibition space of 8500m2, which represents an eleven times growth compared to the previous edition. 

If you go to IndieDev don't forget to stop by the Meridiem Games booth that will take you to a different world, where darkness has ravaged all signs of life and the lost souls of bloodthirsty warriors seek rest in the underworld. There you will meet the demons of the abyss, the darkest creatures, and soulless sorcerers. Darkness hangs over the whole land and there is hardly a glimpse of light. There is no solace for life. But in the high mountains of Selender, a halo of hope has arisen. You have come to light the lands of night and you have a mission, bearer of The Last Flame.  

The Bearer & The Last Flame will be available in 2024 and you can add it to your whistlist now. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44533199/5d7bc0caf4622cd1acefc558d435b59a9afceab5.jpg[/img]

See you soon!
